ModMetaData.name: Better Work Tab
ModMetaData.author: Coolnether123
ModMetaData.description:
Better Work Tab v1.1 port target for RimWorld Alpha 4.
This payload is being prepared for the Alpha 4 compatibility branch.
Compatibility: - Compatible with most work-type mods - [FSF] Complex Jobs column ordering is supported - Vanilla Skills Expanded passion types are supported in rule conditions when the mod is active - Fluffy WorkTab and CompactWorkTab overlap this UI and should not be used together
Version support: - Alpha 4 / 0.4.460 -> v1.1 target - Multiplayer does not work
Support: Discord: https://discord.gg/QYBBaRkKWs
